run_visualize_main: run the visualize module to generate an MP4 video from a pickle file containing video frames and point tracks
run_visualize_input_path: run the visualize script with an input pickle path to load video data and point annotations
run_visualize_output_path: run the visualize script with an output MP4 path to save painted point track frames
run_visualize_decode_frames: run the visualize module to decode JPEG byte frames into numpy arrays for visualization
run_visualize_paint_point_track: run the visualize module to paint point tracks onto video frames using viz_utils.paint_point_track
